supplements.title: EGCG-mediated selenium nanoparticles protect against 5-fluorouracil-induced cardiotoxicity via Nrf2/Keap1 signaling.
supplements.summary: EGCG-selenium nanoparticles protect the heart from 5-fluorouracil chemotherapy damage by reducing oxidative stress and inflammation.

supplements.title: Synergetic anticancer activity of psidium guajava-mediated palladium nanoparticles via apoptosis induction and metastasis suppression in osteosarcoma cells.
supplements.summary: Guava-based palladium nanoparticles effectively kill osteosarcoma (bone cancer) cells by triggering cell death and blocking cancer spread.

supplements.title: Enhancing the therapeutic efficacy of curcumin in topical applications through nanoformulations.
supplements.summary: Nanoformulations enhance curcumin's absorption in skin, improving its effectiveness against skin cancer and wound healing.

supplements.title: Zuoguiyin modulates M2 macrophage polarization to inhibit glycolysis in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Zuoguiyin, a traditional Chinese medicine, reduces esophageal cancer growth by converting immune cells away from tumor-promoting M2 macrophages.

supplements.title: Investigating the 'homotherapy for heteropathy' mechanism of Danggui Shaoyao San in Alzheimer's disease and polycystic ovary syndrome via MAPK signaling pathway and metabolomics.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese medicine formula DSS treats both Alzheimer's disease and ovary syndrome by regulating shared metabolic disorders through MAPK signaling.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective and antioxidant properties of Polygala virgata fractions in a 6-hydroxydopamine-induced neurotoxicity model.
supplements.summary: Polygala virgata plant extract protects brain cells from damage associated with Parkinson's disease through antioxidant effects.

supplements.title: Pharmacological potential of chalepensin from Ruta chalepensis L.: Acute toxicity and in vivo antitumor activity in the L5178Y-R murine model.
supplements.summary: Chalepensin from rue plant shows promise against lymphoma tumors in mice with acceptable safety levels.

supplements.title: Luteolin, a bioactive compound from Celastrus orbiculatus stem, inhibits cervical cancer via CA2 suppression: A translational study bridging basic research and clinical application.
supplements.summary: Luteolin from Celastrus orbiculatus plant fights cervical cancer by suppressing the CA2 protein, offering a natural treatment approach.

supplements.title: Buyang Huanwu Decoction alleviates vascular cognitive impairment by inhibiting neuroinflammation via regulation of the p53/cGAS/STING pathway.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese medicine Buyang Huanwu Decoction reduces brain inflammation and improves cognitive function in vascular cognitive impairment.

supplements.title: Advances in the pharmacology and mechanism of anti-skin aging in Tonifying Traditional Chinese Medicines.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese tonifying medicines address skin aging by restoring internal balance in the body's qi, blood, and organ systems.

supplements.title: A novel monoterpene indole alkaloid from Uncaria sessilifructus Roxb. and its antitumor activity and action mechanism.
supplements.summary: A new plant compound kills leukemia and cervical cancer cells by targeting two key cancer pathways while sparing healthy cells.

supplements.title: β-elemene enhances the efficacy of PD-L1 inhibitor in lung cancer by reprogramming tumor-associated macrophages to M1 phenotype via suppressing FLT1/PI3K/AKT signaling.
supplements.summary: β-elemene combined with PD-L1 inhibitor improves lung cancer treatment by converting immune cells to tumor-fighting M1 phenotype.

supplements.title: Tomatidine modulatesfibrosis-related markers by promoting autophagy in hepatic stellate cells via the ERK/MAPK-mTOR-ULK1 signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Tomatidine, a compound from immature tomatoes, reduces liver fibrosis markers by activating autophagy through a specific cellular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Petiveria alliacea L. methanolic extract inhibits amyloid-β aggregation and enhances cell viability in SH-SY5Y cells: in vitro and in silico evidence.
supplements.summary: Petiveria alliacea plant extract reduces harmful protein buildup and improves brain cell survival in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Senecio scandens Buch. - Ham.: A comprehensive review of botany, phytochemistry, biological activity, toxicity, quality control, application, and practical domain.
supplements.summary: Senecio scandens, a medicinal herb with anti-inflammatory compounds, shows promise for eye and skin diseases but requires safety monitoring.

off_label.title: Identification of PRRG1 as a possible molecular target of pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: PRRG1 protein drives pancreatic cancer growth through a key signaling pathway, and low-dose warfarin effectively blocks this effect.

off_label.title: Targeting UXS1-Dependent Glucuronate Detoxification Potentiates Metformin's Anti-Tumor Efficacy in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking UXS1 enzyme combined with metformin kills lung adenocarcinoma cells and boosts immune responses in preclinical studies.

off_label.title: Quizartinib-induced resistance drives clonal emergence of MV4-11 cells with molecular alterations enabling multidrug antileukemic escape.
off_label.summary: FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia cells develop resistance to quizartinib through genetic mutations and metabolic changes, but combining it with p53 or MAPK inhibitors restores drug sensitivity.

off_label.title: Chronic stress and cancer progression through neuro‑endocrine‑immune networks (Review).
off_label.summary: Chronic stress may accelerate cancer progression through stress hormone pathways affecting immune function and tumor microenvironment, suggesting psychosocial interventions warrant investigation.

off_label.title: NUPR1 as a central stress-adaptation node in cancer: integrating metabolic rewiring, cell death, and therapy resistance.
off_label.summary: NUPR1 protein helps cancers survive stress and resist treatments by controlling metabolism, cell death, and immunity; blocking it with drugs could overcome resistance.

off_label.title: Akkermansia muciniphila drives viscero-visceral crosstalk via 5-HT3aR-mediated sensitization of dichotomizing gut-bladder neurons.
off_label.summary: A gut bacterium (Akkermansia muciniphila) causes bladder dysfunction by triggering excess serotonin, which could be reversed by blocking serotonin receptors.

off_label.title: Metformin inhibits mitochondrial complex I in intestinal epithelium to promote glycaemic control.
off_label.summary: Metformin lowers blood sugar by blocking a protein in intestinal cells, forcing them to absorb excess glucose and convert it to lactate.

off_label.title: A Phase II Pilot Trial of ABemacicliB or Abemaciclib and HydroxYchloroquine to Target Minimal Residual Disease in Breast Cancer Patients ('ABBY')
off_label.summary: A trial tests whether combining abemaciclib and hydroxychloroquine pills can eliminate cancer cells remaining in breast cancer patients' bone marrow.

off_label.title: Burosumab use in fibroblast growth factor-23-mediated hypophosphatemia in McCune-Albright syndrome/fibrous dysplasia.
off_label.summary: Burosumab, an antibody drug, effectively normalized phosphorus levels in a McCune-Albright syndrome patient who failed conventional treatment.

off_label.title: Disrupting sympathetic nerve-tumor crosstalk via biomimetic nanovesicles to augment chemotherapy efficacy under chronic stress.
off_label.summary: Nanovesicles delivering a stress-blocking drug enhance chemotherapy effectiveness in stressed cancer patients by disrupting nerve-tumor communication.

off_label.title: Network pharmacology reveals lidocaine's modulation of proliferation and apoptosis in breast cancer cells: regulation of cellular lipid metabolism.
off_label.summary: Lidocaine reduces breast cancer cell growth and promotes cell death by altering how cancer cells use lipids.

off_label.title: Drug repurposing for skin pigmentation disorders: Discovery of novel tyrosinase inhibitors.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified nine FDA-approved drugs that inhibit tyrosinase, with rosmarinic acid showing promise for treating skin pigmentation disorders.

off_label.title: Ketotifen for Preventing Oxaliplatin-Induced Neuropathy in Stage III Colorectal Cancer: a Randomized Controlled Trial.
off_label.summary: Ketotifen may help prevent nerve damage caused by oxaliplatin chemotherapy in stage III colorectal cancer patients.

off_label.title: Losartan Enhances Radiosensitivity by Reversing Immunosuppressive Tumor Microenvironment Induced by Radiotherapy in TNBC.
off_label.summary: Losartan enhances radiation therapy effectiveness in triple-negative breast cancer by reversing immune suppression in tumors.

off_label.title: Ruxolitinib for ciltacabtagene autoleucel-associated refractory diarrhea.
off_label.summary: Ruxolitinib successfully treated severe diarrhea in multiple myeloma patients after CAR T-cell therapy, showing rapid improvement in all treated cases.

biomarkers.summary: H. pylori bacteria internalize into stomach cells to cause disease and resist antibiotics, suggesting targeting this process could improve treatment.

biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a tumor-targeting system that selectively activates cancer-killing protein-degrading drugs in tumors while sparing healthy tissue.

biomarkers.title: Lipid-based delivery systems for dendritic cell targeting: Formulation strategies and cancer applications.
biomarkers.summary: Lipid-based nanoparticles can deliver cancer antigens directly to dendritic cells, boosting immune responses against tumors.

biomarkers.title: Genetically engineered Salmonella, SGN1, as a tumor microenvironment-targeting modality capable of methionine reduction for oral squamous cell carcinoma.

trials.summary: IL15-activated immune cells given after leukemia transplants achieved lasting remission and strengthened immune recovery in high-risk patients.

trials.title: Self-assembling freeze-dried vaccine for short HLA-A2-restricted melanoma peptide epitopes.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a freeze-dried melanoma vaccine containing multiple peptides that self-assembles into particles, showing strong immune responses in mice.

trials.title: Thermal sonogenetics for adoptive cell transfer therapy.
trials.summary: Ultrasound-triggered heat activates engineered immune cells precisely in tumors, improving safety of cancer immunotherapy.

trials.title: The emerging role of antibody-drug conjugates in EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer with acquired resistance to third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
trials.summary: Antibody-drug conjugates show promise for treating lung cancer patients who develop resistance to standard EGFR-targeted drugs.

trials.title: The current landscape and opportunities in gastrostomy care quality improvement in low- and middle-income countries: a scoping review.
trials.summary: Gastrostomy tube care in low-income countries shows high complication rates; improved training and standardized protocols could enhance patient outcomes.

trials.title: Central nervous system Burkitt lymphoma: fornix-to-ventricle dissemination.
trials.summary: Rare brain Burkitt lymphoma in a teenager spread rapidly from the brain's fornix to ventricles, highlighting the importance of prompt biopsy diagnosis.
